title: Repentance unto Life
definition: Repentance unto Life is a grace-given turning from sin to God with grief over sin and desire for obedience.
summary: Repentance unto Life is the grace-enabled turning from sin to God that accompanies saving faith.
christFocus: Jesus Christ calls sinners to repent and gives mercy to those who come humbly to Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Repentance unto life is not despair, self-punishment, or an attempt to earn forgiveness. It is the Spirit-given change of mind and heart that sees sin as rebellion and turns to Christ for mercy. This doctrine keeps repentance connected to hope, because the sinner turns away from death and toward the living Savior.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because repentance is often reduced either to shame or to vague apology. Biblical repentance grieves sin but does not stop at grief; it moves toward God, confession, obedience, and renewed trust. It guards discipleship from cheap grace and from crushing condemnation.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Confess sin honestly without hiding behind excuses. Ask the Lord to give you hatred for sin and hunger for Christ. Practice repentance as a daily return to grace, not as a way to punish yourself.
